name: Melody Music Bot
description: 🎶 Premium Telegram Music Bot — YouTube streaming, AutoPlay, Lyrics, Colored Controls

STRING_SESSION.description: Pyrogram string session of assistant/userbot account

OWNER_NAME.description: Alias shown in play cards (e.g. Maestro) — NOT your real name

LOG_GROUP_ID.description: Private Telegram group ID for error logs (e.g. -1001234567890). Must be a group where YOUR bot is an admin -- do not reuse an example/old ID.

WEBAPP_URL.description: HTTPS URL where web_app/index.html is hosted (GitHub Pages / Vercel)

GENIUS_API_TOKEN.description: Genius API token from genius.com/api-clients (for lyrics)

YT_COOKIES.description: Paste the raw contents of a cookies.txt exported from a browser logged into youtube.com (Netscape format). Base64 also accepted. Strongly recommended on Heroku to avoid bot-detection blocks.
